title: #Gamelab2018 - Jon Blow's Design decisions on creating Jai a new language for game programmers
summary: Jonathan Blow talks at Gamelab 2018 about the design decisions behind Jai, the programming language he is building for game programmers. He covers low-friction development, quality of life and the effects of compile times.
why: Recommended for a substantive look at language design priorities and a critique of why modern programming feels broken.

quote.text: I recently watched this talk by Johnathan Blow[0] where he talks about quality of life in programming languages and spends a fair amount of time talking about compile times and their effects.
